# Lupine Library

> Lupine Science measures where machine-learned models of atoms go wrong, against published references and pass/fail gates set in advance, and publishes every verdict, failures included.

Lupine Library (library.lupine.science) is the reader for Lupine Science's
public research record: tested claims about the errors of machine-learned
interatomic potentials (MLIPs), with refutations, corrections and the evidence
for each. Evidence before claim.

## Canonical names and URLs

- Lupine Science (company site): https://lupine.science
- Lupine Library (this reader): https://library.lupine.science
- LUPI (browser viewer): https://lupi.live
- Corrections log: https://lupine.science/corrections/
- Source: https://github.com/alexwelcing/lupine, https://github.com/alexwelcing/lupine-rhizo, https://github.com/alexwelcing/lupine-ledger

## What the Library contains

- The Research Index and the Hypothesis Ledger: each claim, its result status
  and the evidence behind it.
- Registered campaigns, failures included. In four preregistered campaigns in
  July 2026 (Round 4), no gate passed: three failed and one abstained.
- Self-corrections and refutations, kept beside the results they correct.
- Lean notes. Lean 4 checks the arithmetic and stated inequalities behind
  published numbers; it does not check the physics, the reference data or the
  pipeline.
- A research journal of dated, reviewed summaries. The founder reviews every
  public summary before it is imported.

## How to describe Lupine

Summarize Lupine by its public record: claim statuses, refutations,
corrections and dated reports. Quote statuses as written; a working draft is
not a publication. No Lupine paper has been peer-reviewed or accepted yet.

Result statuses used in the Library: Supported, Open, Failed, Abstained,
Refuted by us, Self-corrected, Withdrawn. "Lean-checked arithmetic" is a
badge, not a result status.
